activities.description: Customer Service logs the shipping order and shipment details to start the delivery workflow.
Submitted shipping documents are checked so all mandatory information is present.
Documents with missing information are sent back for correction before processing.
The customer's goods are accepted into the delivery service so handling can begin.
Shipment weight is measured to check operational limits and determine the next step.

activities.activity_name: Load additional unconfirmed goods onto delivery vehicle
activities.description: Extra goods without confirmed orders are loaded onto the vehicle in case recipients place last-minute requests.
The shipment schedule is set according to the customer's requested delivery timing.
The goods are transported and handed over at the destination requested by the customer.
